senses.gloss:
अर्ब्ब r. 1st. cl. (अर्ब्बति)
 1. To go, to go to or towards.
 2. To kill or hurt.
See अर्व्व.

अर्ब्बुद mn. (-दः-दं)
 1. Ophthalmia.
 2. A hundred millions.
 m. (-दः)
 1.
The name of a mountain in the west of India, commonly Abu, a
place of pilgrimage, especially to the Jainas.
 2. An indolent
swelling.
 E. अर्ब्ब to injure. उदच् affix; the root and derivative are
also written with the dental letter.
